# X Bookmarks

> Donovin's saved X (Twitter) bookmarks posted on or after 2026-06-01 (America/Chicago), one Markdown file per bookmark. 366 bookmarks. Exported 2026-10-31T15:49:50-05:00.

Post text is exactly as shown on X: original line breaks, t.co links expanded, hidden media and quote links removed.

## Files

- [index.md](https://donovinsims.github.io/x-bookmarks/index.md): table of every bookmark (date, author, kind, category, title, link to its file)
- [bookmarks.jsonl](https://donovinsims.github.io/x-bookmarks/bookmarks.jsonl): one JSON object per line; every frontmatter field plus title, text (full post text), file, md_url. Best for bulk reading.
- md/<YYYY-MM-DD>-<handle>-<id>.md: one file per bookmark, e.g. https://donovinsims.github.io/x-bookmarks/md/... (filenames are stable; date is the post date in America/Chicago)

## Markdown file schema

YAML frontmatter, every key always present, values JSON-encoded:
- id (string), url (string), author_handle (string), author_name (string)
- posted_at (string, ISO 8601 UTC), kind ("post" | "article" | "quote")
- category (string), purpose (string[]), projects (string[]), takeaway (string)
- likes (integer), favorite (boolean), has_media (boolean)
- media ({type, url}[]; type is photo | video | animated_gif)
- quoted ({id, url, author, text} or null; text is the quoted post's text or article title)
- notes (string), source ("x_bookmark"), exported_at (string, ISO 8601)

Body, in this order: "# <title or first line>", "## Post" (exact text), then only when present "## Quoted post" (blockquote), "## Media" (list of type: url), "## Notes".
UTF-8, LF line endings, no HTML.
